daily_kpi: MET before this additional study — multiple distinct real-data backtests were completed earlier on 2026-11-25
data_scope: FRED ANFCI weekly, SP500 and VIXCLS daily; ANFCI coverage 2016-11-25 to 2026-11-20; price coverage 2016-11-28 to 2026-11-24; 430 accepted non-overlapping weekly events; validation 2019–2021; test 2022 onward
disposition: REJECTED — the augmented model fails to improve either period and paired-loss inference indicates it is worse

event_construction.event_spacing: weekly observations; target windows must not overlap; equality at the next signal close is allowed
event_construction.signal_rule: first S&P 500 close on or after week-ending Friday + 7 calendar days; exact same-date VIX required

limitations: ANFCI historical observations are revised; current FRED vintage is used and historical release vintages are not reconstructed.

The seven-calendar-day lag is conservative relative to the published Wednesday 8:30 a.m. ET release (Thursday on specified holiday weeks), but does not eliminate revisions to prior ANFCI observations.
ANFCI is a composite and not an exogenous funding shock; components can overlap with information in VIX and equity markets.
SP500 is a cash price index, not an executable futures series or total-return index.
Forecasting only: no causal claim, transaction-cost model, tradable strategy or live deployment conclusion.
No raw source data are committed; only hashes, retrieval metadata and aggregate metrics are retained.

methodology.feature: ANFCI_week_t - ANFCI_week_t_minus_4; positive means tightening over four weekly observations
methodology.release_rule: weekly observation dated Friday; conservatively available Friday + 7 calendar days; first S&P 500 close on or after that date
methodology.target: log1p(next-five-session S&P 500 realized volatility in percent)
methodology.training_rule: training target_end_date must be strictly earlier than current signal_date
